player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between the Nursery and the Billiard room, repeatedly going east and then west. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I never noticed that I was visiting the same rooms multiple times and never actually explored all the rooms. Next time, I will keep track of the rooms I have visited and avoid revisiting them. I will also make sure to explore all the available directions from each room before deciding which one to take. If I notice that I'm repeating moves, I will take a new, untried direction instead.
